content:
My name is Claude, and I'm an AI assistant made by Anthropic.

What I do: I have conversations with people to help with a wide range of tasks—answering questions, explaining concepts, helping with writing and editing, working through problems, brainstorming ideas, coding assistance, analysis, and general discussion on topics someone wants to explore.

Is there something specific I can help you with?
